description: Translate YouTube captions into Simplified Chinese using the AI connection configured in MacHelper.
capabilities: Show source captions and Simplified Chinese together over the YouTube player.
exampleQueries: Watch YouTube in English with Chinese subtitles.
limitations: Requires captions available to the YouTube viewer, the OnlineSubtitle Chrome companion, and a working MacHelper AI connection.

en.Translate YouTube captions into Simplifi: Translate YouTube captions into Simplified Chinese using the AI connection configured in MacHelper.
en.Show source captions and Simplified Chin: Show source captions and Simplified Chinese together over the YouTube player.
